data.body:
Delivered as Gerrit 2263, merged as 43f783de2a2d.

Attribution: **unattributable**, recorded deliberately rather than guessed. This is an
omission, not a regression — no commit introduced it. The leaked processes were ad-hoc
`python -c` invocations from agent sessions; `while True: pass` appears nowhere in the
codebase, so `git log -S` and blame have no target. Nor is there a story whose scope
should have covered 'AGENTS.md must require bounded background spawns' — the guidance
gap predates any ticket that could own it. Searches: `git log -S 'while True: pass'`,
`git log --grep` over spawn/orphan/timeout, and a tracker sweep for orphaned-process
guidance, all empty. Closing `--class=preexisting` with no `--caused-by`.

Scope note: the delivered check narrows PPID-1 + CPU-time by suppressing OS-vendor and
endpoint-management executables, because on macOS launchd parents every daemon to PID 1
— unfiltered it reported 33, of which 29 were system daemons. The four survivors
included a real orphaned agent-job script the noise had buried. That AC was added mid-
implementation on measured evidence and re-reviewed before the close.
